finding: An existing local fact established the worker was present and could be addressed across the counter. After proposing an inquiry, the actor requested the conversation condition again instead of asking. Independent meaningful-direction review rejected the repeated preparation.
rootCauseLead: The choice treats background-worker contact as requiring addition to the conversation roster. The input limits registered participant audiences. Whether this wording causes the failure requires a versioned correction and verification; this run alone does not prove causation.
scope: Bounded development observation using real adopted source units, first passing generated opening and preregistered neutral inputs; no automatic retry or repair after failure.
